_doc: Quake III style rename map (AGENTS.md, Project profile), regenerated by tools/rename_map.py and applied by tools/rename.py. Each entry: old name -> {new, unit/header owner}; 'keep' gives the reason a name stays; 'reworded' marks a change beyond case and prefix, with its reason; 'ambiguous' members are left for manual handling. Locals and parameters follow _rules.locals_parameters.

_rules.locals_parameters: not mapped individually: rename.py applies snake_case -> lowerCamel (words after the first capitalised, acronyms upper-case as in the map) to every remaining identifier with an inner underscore that is not an explicit map entry, an SDK/library name, a lineage name or an address placeholder; names without an inner underscore (i, ent, dir, self, x) are kept
_rules.members: renamed per owning struct; a snake_case member whose new name is the plain lowerCamel conversion is renamed by the same rule as locals (one spelling everywhere); entries marked ambiguous are left for manual handling
_rules.tags: struct/union tags become lowerCamel_s, enum tags lowerCamel_t; the tool renames a tag only where it follows struct/union/enum
